fusions.name: Sowing
fusions.desc: Looses an arrow that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Rootbind
fusions.desc: Looses an arrow at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 11 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, and stuns it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Fletching Bed
fusions.desc: Grows a patch of plants 3 tiles across for 10 seconds. You and your allies inside it regain 3 health a second.

fusions.name: Roots Drink
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
